title: Armstrong Number Check
statement:
A non-negative integer with `k` digits is an **Armstrong number** (also called a narcissistic number) if it equals the sum of its digits each raised to the power `k`.

For example `153` has `k = 3` digits and `1^3 + 5^3 + 3^3 = 1 + 125 + 27 = 153`, so it is an Armstrong number. Every single-digit number (including `0`) is one, because `d^1 = d`.

Given `N`, print `YES` if it is an Armstrong number and `NO` otherwise.

complexity.time: O(d) where d is the number of digits

hints: First find k, the number of digits of N.
Peel off digits with `% 10` and `// 10`, adding each digit raised to the power k.
Compare the sum with the original N, not with the number left after peeling digits.
